text:
julia: Heads-up — planning a canary for routing-v2 tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Goal: verify latency and error rates on small cohorts before wider ramp. Proposal: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~45m with pauses at each step. Need smoke owners + rollback owner. who can take smoke checks? :eyes:

sam: I can own the 09:00 smoke window. I'll validate login flow, end-to-end inference, and check per-route p95. Will post checklist results in this thread. :+1:

kai: I’ll be the rollback owner. If metrics breach thresholds at any step I’ll trigger rollback and coordinate. I have the rollback runbook pinned: https://wiki/redundant/rollbacks/routing-v2

anita: Cohort selection: suggest US-WEST1 (1%) + EU-WEST1 (5%), exclude APAC for the initial wedge. User cohorts: beta and enterprise-tier only. This avoids mobile-heavy traffic during the test.

julia: sounds good. I'll schedule the deploy window and add 5m hold at each pause so we can triage. Can we agree on pass/fail criteria?

sam: pass = 1) no increase >2% error rate, 2) p95 latency change < 25ms, 3) no regression in token-cost per request. If any fail -> rollback. I'll publish numeric checks after preflight smoke.

kai: agree. Also keep an eye on queue length and GPU mem pressure. If queue > 200/s or OOMs appear, rollback immediately.

julia: preflight items (I'll run these 30m before):
```
- infra healthcheck (nodes ready)
- canary image sha verified
- config flags set (routing.v2.enabled=false -> staged)
- alert triggers set to stricter thresholds
```

anita: one more: confirm model-variant pinning for the cohort (quantized-v2) so we don't mix runtimes. I already validated artifacts.

sam: I'll run the smoke script once deploy hits 1%: `/scripts/smoke/run_routing_checks.sh --cohort beta` and paste results.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by julia: routing-v2 canary -> 2026-03-18 09:00 PDT. Steps: 1% @09:00, 5% @09:10, 25% @09:25, 100% @09:40. Pauses enabled.

julia: reminder — if anyone can't make the window, call out now so we can swap owners. Otherwise I'll start the staged rollout tomorrow.

kai: I'll be online and reachable on my pager. ping me @kai if you see metric spike.

sam: all set from my side. I'll post a quick smoke summary after the 1% step.

anita: config and artifact checks done. good to go. :rocket:
